name: Wolha
tagline: Chat with K-webtoon male leads — and answer them back.
description: Wolha is a browser-based interactive romance app built on K-webtoon archetypes: a cold northern duke, a contract-marriage CEO, a secret idol. You pick a character and an opening scene, then type your own words instead of tapping a scripted choice. The character answers, remembers the conversation in summary, and changes tone by affection and trust. 12 languages, iOS and Android apps, freemium with 5 free turns.
